description: This file defines the InterviewAttachment entity class, which models a database table for storing interview attachment data in the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It includes properties such as filename, type, size, content, and comment, along with getters and setters. The class is annotated for Doctrine ORM mapping to facilitate database persistence.

classes.name: InterviewAttachment
classes.description: A Doctrine ORM entity representing interview attachments, with properties for storing attachment details and relationships. Supports decorator pattern via DecoratorTrait.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the attachment.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Associates an Interview object with this attachment.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type (MIME type) of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the file type (MIME type) of the attachment.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: setFileSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the file, as a resource or string.

methods.name: setFileContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the file.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns the comment associated with the attachment.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the attachment.
